files.lines: SEL4_ARCH_INVOCATION_TEMPLATE (lines ~70-89, the enum sel4_arch_invocation_label); ARCH_INVOCATION_TEMPLATE (~103-122) has the same pattern
files.why: When the invocations list is empty (ia32) the `first` label never gets `= nInvocationLabels`, so the terminating nSeL4ArchInvocationLabels (and likewise nArchInvocationLabels) is 0; the terminator must be initialised to the previous count when `first` is still set (e.g. `{{if first}}nSeL4ArchInvocationLabels = nInvocationLabels{{else}}nSeL4ArchInvocationLabels{{endif}}`).

files.lines: p_tagged_union (~229-232) grammar and lexer; class TaggedUnion (~1259-1340, __init__/resolve); C code generation for tag read/eq/write/creation (templates ~359-480 and generate()); generate_hol_defs/generate_hol_proofs (~1339-1620)
files.why: The only bitfield generator and the sole place that parses `tagged_union` and assumes a single contiguous tag field, so it must accept `<field>[:<field>]*`, validate same position/width in all blocks, use the OR'd tag mask, and skip field accessors for tag fields.

files.lines: grammar p_tagged_union (~229-245); TaggedUnion.__init__/make_classes (1259-1300, 2056-2165); TaggedUnion.generate (1744-1960: tag enum, get_tag, tag_equals, ptr_get_tag, creation); generate_hol_defs/generate_hol_proofs (1339-1700); Block field emission (~2612 suppressed tag field)
files.why: The bitfield generator is the only place that parses `tagged_union` and assumes a single contiguous tag field, so it must accept `<field>[:<field>]*`, check the fields sit at the same position and width in every block, use the OR of their masks as the tag mask, emit plain-number enum values, read the tag with the combined mask, and suppress field accessors for every tag field.

files.lines: handleInterruptEntry(), lines 37-47: `irq = getActiveIRQ();` at line 41 before the CONFIG_KERNEL_MCS block
files.why: Move the getActiveIRQ() call to after the MCS updateTimestamp()/checkBudget() block, so the timestamp is taken before the interrupt controller is queried and the thread isn't billed for that time.

files.lines: ANSI_RESET/ANSI_GREEN/ANSI_DARK definitions (lines ~104-110) and the userError-style macro using them (~lines 138-139)
files.why: ANSI_DARK sets foreground to black bold (\033[30;1m) and ANSI_GREEN sets green, which collide with dark terminal backgrounds; they should be replaced with bold-only (or a non-black/white colour) styling.

files.lines: SEL4_ARCH_INVOCATION_TEMPLATE (lines ~70-89, the `nSeL4ArchInvocationLabels` terminator) and, for the same flaw, ARCH_INVOCATION_TEMPLATE (lines ~103-122, `nArchInvocationLabels`)
files.why: When the invocations list is empty (ia32) the `first` branch never emits `= nInvocationLabels`, so the terminating enumerator needs to be given that start value (e.g. `{{if first}} nSeL4ArchInvocationLabels = nInvocationLabels {{else}} nSeL4ArchInvocationLabels {{endif}}`); the arch template needs the same treatment with `nSeL4ArchInvocationLabels`.

Needs a 4K-aligned block that places the trap vector (.vectors) and fastpath sections (.vectors.fastpath_call, .vectors.fastpath_reply_recv, .vectors.text) adjacently before the generic .text, as common_arm.lds does.

files.lines: `.section .text` at line 17; trap_entry; `j c_handle_fastpath_call` / `j c_handle_fastpath_reply_recv` / `j c_handle_syscall` (lines ~110-147)
files.why: trap_entry must move into the dedicated vectors section, and the fastpath dispatch can then use short conditional branches instead of a check followed by a jump.
These fastpath entry functions need a SECTION(".vectors.fastpath_*") attribute so the linker script can place them next to trap_entry.

files.lines: handleInterruptEntry(), lines 37-68 (the getActiveIRQ() call at line 41)
files.why: Move `irq = getActiveIRQ();` to after the CONFIG_KERNEL_MCS updateTimestamp()/checkBudget() block so budget accounting happens before the interrupt is queried.
